required_changes: Materialize this readiness snapshot on an isolated control branch
Bind exact accepted P23 and P20+CR01 input identities
Record actual repository baseline and ancestry without claiming qualification
Record M01-M04 and execution-sequence readiness without changing upstream decisions
forbidden_changes: Existing .aegis registries, packages, results, Gates or verification locks
Production code, proto, descriptor generation/publication or semantic algorithm changes
Automatic P32 start, feature-order acceleration, merge to main, or fabricated evidence

required.command_or_oracle: Read all four source archives; recompute manifest/SHA256SUMS and CRC; preserve their original bytes
required.expected_result: All listed file hashes match; nested original inputs match external input identities
required.blocking_reason: Wrong input bytes would bind a different design

required.command_or_oracle: Verify effective catalog has 60 unique logical IDs, covered exactly once by ten obligation families, with CR01 delta preserved
required.expected_result: No dropped, duplicated or invented case family

required.command_or_oracle: Inspect package hashes, exact baseline/ancestry evidence, authorized paths and non-executable flags
required.expected_result: Only new readiness files; every local package ref resolves; P32 remains false
required.blocking_reason: Prevent an incomplete binding from becoming implementation authorization

optional: Control-file syntax checks if already available; never use these as FC-08 product evidence

blocking: Exact repository/ref for the readiness files
Content hashes for all package-local refs

all_of: Readiness package and its limits are durably resolvable
Input identities and local package references are consistent
Unresolved product implementation bindings remain visible
No production, global Gate or main-branch mutation

product_execution_unlock: Requires a separate completed FC-08 implementation package after exact M01-M04 and sequence bindings; this package cannot unlock itself.
